slides.title: You never need ==logs== on this test
slides.hand: type the function, read the answer

slides.title: Define the function, then ask for a value
slides.question: A population of $800$ grows by $50\%$ each year. What is the population after $3$ years?
slides.caption: Define $p(x) = 800(1.5)^x$, then type $p(3)$. Desmos prints the value right next to it.

slides.title: "When does it drop below?" is a crossing
slides.question: A sample starts at $1{,}200$ and halves every year. After how many years does it reach $300$?
slides.caption: Graph the decay and the target as a flat line $y = 300$. The crossing is the answer.

slides.title: Half-life questions never need logarithms
slides.question: A substance has a half-life of $3$ hours. Starting from $160$ mg, how much remains after $3$ hours?
slides.caption: Type $h(3)$. One half-life gone, half the amount left.
